annotations.title: Capture a simulator's or emulator's screen

description: Saves what a booted iOS Simulator (xcrun simctl) or Android emulator or device (adb screencap) shows now, as a PNG, and says which of the store's types take it as it is. It only captures: run the app and bring it to the screen first; nothing is installed, booted or launched. Saved under the app's store/screenshots/<platform>/ unless folder says otherwise; an alpha channel is removed, since the stores refuse transparency. Pick the device by name or ID when several are running; list: true only lists them. For Apple's sizes, capture on the simulator ploa_screenshot_specs names (an iPhone 17 Pro Max gives the 6.9-inch 1320×2868).

device.description: The simulator's name or UDID, or the Android device's serial or model.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.

list.description: Only list the running simulators and devices.

name.description: The file's name, like 01-home.png. Defaults to the device and the time.

platform.description: Needed only when both an iOS Simulator and an Android device are running.
